name: Hunter.io e-mail discovery API v2 (keyed; domain-search, email-count, email-finder only)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted): 'Hunter is an established company: tier trusted.' (P090 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Addresses Hunter found published on the web, with its own confidence score; guessed (finder) addresses are hypotheses (P090 cond 3).

hunter.description: Hunter.io API key (api_key query parameter: masked by the central redaction, AR01)
hunter.plan_hint: business = a company/team Hunter account on a plan recorded by legal before it runs under the corporate profile (P090 cond 5); the free plan has 25 searches per month

domain_search.title: Hunter domain-search (GET https://api.hunter.io/v2/domain-search?domain=&limit=10&api_key=): address pattern and addresses of a domain - verified own domains only

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal before it runs under corporate. Monthly credits (free plan 25 searches/month) via the P334 block.

sanitizer.notes: P090 cond 4 minimisation before the HTTP cache: names, positions, seniority, phone numbers, LinkedIn/Twitter handles, source URLs, company profile fields and Hunter's own verification/accept_all verdicts (SMTP checks on its side) are dropped; only the address, its type, confidence, department and the first/last-seen dates of its sources survive.

domain_search.notes: Research C0208 (verified_needs_key: 401 authentication_failed without a key). Own-asset-only (A11 BR4, P090 cond 2): the module runs with run_on='own_assets_only' (txt_verified/attested org-profile entries). Key 'hunter' (config.KNOWN_KEYS, env HUNTER_API_KEY / V3LUM_HUNTER_KEY) travels as api_key= in the query string: the central redaction (AR01) masks it in every URL that is cached, logged, emitted or stored (P090 cond 5). Used by hunter_io.

email_count.title: Hunter email-count (GET https://api.hunter.io/v2/email-count?domain=|company=&api_key=): address counts by type, department and seniority - no addresses

terms.quote: Third-party domains get email-count only (counts, no addresses), inside a case with a recorded purpose.

email_count.notes: Hunter documents email-count as free of credits; the formerly keyless call answers 401 authentication_failed (research 2026-11-25), so the key is required. Used by hunter_io (own domains) and hunter_io_count (third-party domains and company names, case with a recorded purpose).

email_finder.title: Hunter email-finder (GET https://api.hunter.io/v2/email-finder?domain=&first_name=&last_name=&api_key=): one guessed address for a named person

terms.quote: email-finder only for a person the analyst typed inside a case with a recorded purpose; person_name modules are never default (A3).

sanitizer.notes: P090 cond 3/4: the echoed name, position, phone, social handles, company and Hunter's verification verdict are dropped; the guessed address is a generated value (expand=False).

email_finder.notes: HTTP 451 'unavailable_for_legal_reasons' = the person asked Hunter not to process their data (honoured: no result is kept). Used by hunter_io_finder. The email-verifier endpoint is never wired (rule 2: SMTP probing on our behalf, P090 cond 1).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G04-1 (P090 hunter_io, hunter_io_count, hunter_io_finder; the offline hunter_sender_check needs no provider). flags.sensitive: a people-data provider (employee addresses, names, phones; A4 BR1) - the per-source P145 schemas run before the HTTP cache (TTL <= 7 days) and the module only ever sees the kept fields. The key 'hunter' is the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS entry; this block adds the V3LUM_HUNTER_KEY alias and the plan hint.
